mapper.insert: INSERT INTO game_exercise_member (room_id, user_id, nickname, team, ready, bot, score, kills, deaths, assists, joined_at, left_at) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{userId}, #{nickname}, #{team}, #{ready}, #{bot}, #{score}, #{kills}, #{deaths}, #{assists}, #{joinedAt}, #{leftAt})

INSERT INTO game_exercise_result (id, room_id, mode, user_id, nickname, team, rank_no, score, kills, deaths, assists, winner, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{roomId}, #{mode}, #{userId}, #{nickname}, #{team}, #{rankNo}, #{score}, #{kills}, #{deaths}, #{assists}, #{winner}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE game_exercise_member SET ready = #{ready} WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE game_exercise_member SET left_at = #{now} WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND left_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM game_exercise_result WHERE mode <> 'TRAINING' ORDER BY created_at DESC, rank_no ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM game_exercise_room WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND state_json IS NOT NULL ORDER BY started_at ASC
